blind_spots.blind_spot: Claims a fully local, zero-network architecture but never explains how provenance data rolls up for leadership reporting or ATO evidence across a distributed, disconnected DoD dev workforce.
blind_spots.operator_reality: A DDIL-friendly local-only design sounds right, but without a described sync/aggregation path, the 'leadership sees ROI at a glance' promise and the 'no network calls' promise directly contradict each other the moment this needs to serve more than one disconnected site.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Product was built for commercial enterprise dev teams first; the disconnected multi-site DoD rollup problem wasn't the design constraint.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Nothing leaves your machines - no server, no network calls, just local provenance data you control and can trust.

blind_spots.blind_spot: Deep CVE/CWE/KEV/EPSS vocabulary but zero mention of the platform's own ATO/RMF/IL4-IL5 path for running on a DoD network.
blind_spots.operator_reality: A tool that inventories AI/software risk for an Air Force customer will itself need to sit inside the accreditation boundary it reports on — without ATO/RMF language, this looks like a tool built to sell risk data, not to survive the accreditation gate that determines whether it's ever actually installed.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Team is fluent in software supply-chain security concepts (their product domain) but the pack shows no evidence they've internalized that their own product is a system requiring its own authorization.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Cross-link CVEs, CWEs, KEV and EPSS.

blind_spots.blind_spot: The workflow implicitly assumes live, ongoing capture of AI-tool API calls, but the personas and messaging never address the classified, air-gapped dev environment that is exactly where the AFWERX-funded 'software-contributor mapping' use case would run.
blind_spots.operator_reality: In a SCIF or IL5 dev environment, there often is no outbound API call to log, no consumer AI tool to instrument, and no continuous 'ROI dashboard' feed — the product's core loop (capture AI activity, then converse with it via an LLM interface) needs exactly the connectivity a classified DoD dev shop won't have.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Positioning is aimed at commercial engineering orgs (Leadership/Engineering Teams/Developers) rather than the classified software factory their SBIR customer actually represents.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Everyone Wins ... Leadership ... Engineering Teams ... Developers

opener_hook: SettleTop's AFWERX Phase II SBIR ($1.25M, awarded July 2023) funded a software-contributor mapping platform for Air Force supply-chain security — that period of performance is now roughly two years past its start.
what_they_do: AI/software provenance and governance SaaS (CodeRoot) that traces AI-assisted code contributions for risk, compliance, and ROI reporting.
